name: 2 MW row CDU

sources.title: StorageReview: CoolIT unveils CHx2000 CDU with 2 MW capacity

summary: Row-scale liquid-to-liquid coolant distribution unit of about 2 MW, enough for up to twelve 120 kW NVL72 racks.

capacityW.note: CoolIT CHx2000 is marketed at 2 MW in a 750 × 1200 mm footprint.

maxFlowLps.note: 1.2 L/min per kW of capacity (CoolIT CHx2000 rating) × 2000 kW = 2400 L/min = 40 L/s.

approachK.note: Vertiv rates its CoolChip CDU 2300 at 2300 kW with a 4 °C approach temperature difference; CoolIT does not publish one for CHx2000.

pumpPowerW.note: Hydraulic power 40 L/s × 365 kPa (53 psi CHx2000 secondary head) = 14.6 kW, divided by a 0.6 wire-to-water efficiency = 24 kW at full flow and full head.

weightKg.note: Scaled from the 1.2 MW unit: larger heat exchanger and pumps, plus about 300 L of coolant.

capexUsd.note: About 170 USD per kW of capacity (judgment, slight economy of scale against the 1.2 MW class), equipment only.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Judgment: newest high-capacity CDUs ship in smaller volumes than 1 MW-class units, so lead times run longer.
